title: Joint Material Reconstruction for Sparse Dual-Energy CT

contributions.purpose: 稀疏视角低剂量DECT的联合材料重建
contributions.mechanism: 材料域变分:跨通道矢量全变分(VTV)耦合两谱通道 + 投影域gap-aware角密度加权抑制条纹,凸复合目标
contributions.source_quote: a joint reconstruction framework for dual-kVp CT that couples both spectral channels through a vectorial total variation (VTV) prior ... we incorporate gap-aware angle-density weighting in the data fidelity term.

contributions.mechanism: 预条件PDHG,power-iteration保守步长,FBP热启动,原始更新加非负约束
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称稀疏视角下稳定可复现收敛(单run,无error bar)
contributions.source_quote: A robust PDHG solver with conservative preconditioning, FBP warm-starts, and non-negativity constraints, ensuring stable and reproducible convergence.

contributions.mechanism: 基于scikit-image Radon/iradon,含几何/能量匹配safeguard
contributions.evaluation: 定性;称将随补充材料开放
contributions.source_quote: A practical open-source reference implementation built on scikit-image, with safeguards for consistent geometry and energy matching in DECT pipelines.

self_declared_provenance.quote: it builds upon established convex optimization frameworks (PDHG, TV). The assumptions are implementation-level and already stated in the methods section.
